title: Creating Airships
description: A modpack focused around aeronautics powered airships, and floating islands.
body: A create modpack focused on building airships, and exploring sky islands, featuring custom terrrain from Terralith, and sky islands from Aerolith. This is mainly just a collection of create addons to make life simpler, with simple cobblestone generators, and better gearboxes, to Big Cannons to allow you to blow up your friends in style.
